legal_name: ZEN-NOH International Hong Kong Food Limited

sources.evidence: ZEN-NOH's official global network lists ZEN-NOH International Hong Kong Food Limited as a Hong Kong subsidiary at Vanta Industrial Centre in Kwai Chung.
The Hong Kong SAR Government states that ZEN-NOH International Corporation opened a Hong Kong food factory operated by ZEN-NOH International Hong Kong Food Limited in Kwai Chung on 17 March 2023.
sources.publisher: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
